messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — noticing spikes of AER/Xid on rack17 GPUs, several jobs stalled, perf drops ~40%.
maria_g: Seen it too, metrics show NVLink error bursts around 2025-03-12T09:42Z. Which nodes?
alex_k: nodes r17-n[02-06], Xid 31 repeating and 'NVLINK error: link down/up' in dmesg.
liam_ops: dumping last logs: 
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:83:00): 31, pid=12035, ...
[ 1234.567891] pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: AER: Multiple Uncorr Error
[ 1234.567892] nvlink0: link 2 down
```
samira_eng: can we cordon/drain those nodes? running long training jobs though.
jonathan: recommend quick cordon + live-migrate/bounce jobs hitting those gpus. Use drain script: `./scripts/drain-gpus --rack rack17 --force --wait 300`
liam_ops: started cordon on r17-n02,r17-n03. Will throttle new scheduling. Pinged scheduler to avoid filling.
alex_k: also noticed ECC corrected counts rising. Might be thermal + bios fan spin-up. Anyone onsite to reseat power connectors?
maria_g: ops team on rotation, @liam_ops can you check chassis logs (ipmi sel) and run `nvidia-bug-report.sh` for one node?
liam_ops: running `nvidia-bug-report.sh --log` now, uploading to s3://redwood-support/rack17/bugreports/1902109876.zip
gpu-monitor-bot: ALERT rack17: pcie_aer_rate=12/min, nvlink_flaps=8/min, failed_jobs=6
samira_eng: short-term plan: 1) cordon affected nodes 2) route traffic to spare pool in us-west-2 3) collect bugreports and diag 4) replace any card with persistent Xid 31 after onsite inspection
alex_k: long-term: enable more aggressive NVLink ECC logging, add automated drain on repeated AER events, consider 'pci=noaer' only for debugging (not for prod). Also open support case with vendor for suspect cards.
maria_g: noted cost/regional constraints — moving to spare pool will increase cross-region egress for a bit; finance ok with short bump. ops, proceed with reseat and RMA triage.
liam_ops: onsite confirmed loose riser on r17-n04; reseated and rebooted. Monitoring for 20m.
alex_k: after reseat NVLink flaps dropped to 0. Perf back up ~12%. Keeping nodes cordoned until 1h clean window.
jonathan: tagging this thread with incident-2025-03-12-rack17 for postmortem. Will schedule postmortem tomorrow.
